title: Doduo 084/165 Near Mint Pokeball Reverse Holo 151 Japanese Pokemon SV2a 2023
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Doduo card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG collector! With a beautiful Reverse Holo finish and a card number of 084/165, this card is sure to impress. The card features the beloved character Doduo and is part of the 151 set, manufactured by Nintendo in Japan.

The card is in fantastic shape and has been well-maintained, ready for you to add to your collection. It's a Standard size card and has not been autographed. This Unlimited edition card is perfect for any fan of the game and is sure to be a valuable addition to your collection. Don't miss out on this opportunity to own a piece of Pokémon history!
